"""Pydantic and dataclass models for the agent-stream router."""

from __future__ import annotations

import src.key_catalog
import asyncio
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Literal

from langchain_core.language_models import BaseChatModel
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from cloud.services.checkpointer import InterruptManager
from src.agui.blockers import AiUnavailableDecision
from cloud.services.event_buffer import EventBuffer
from src.agui import PlannerToAGUIAdapter
from src.autopilot.graph.run_summary import SummaryModelProtocol
from src.types.types import JsonValue
from src.types.typed import JsonObject

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from cloud.services.agent_runner import TerminalRunObserver


class AgentStreamRequest(BaseModel):
    request_id: str | None = None
    plan_id: str | None = None
    trace_id: str | None = None
    thread_id: str | None = None
    # Duplicate fields with cloud/models/bridge.py BridgePlanFormRequest
    idempotency_key: str | None = None
    url: str | None = None
    hostname: str | None = None
    controls: list[dict[str, object]] = Field(default_factory=list)
    profile_data: dict[str, object] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    executor_backend: Literal["playwright"] | None = None
    enable_llm_judge: bool | None = None
    a11y_context: dict[str, object] | None = None
    max_repair_calls: int | None = None
    enable_runtime_learning: bool | None = None
    debug_enabled: bool | None = None

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")


class InterruptResponse(BaseModel):
    run_id: str
    control_id: str
    decision: Literal["approved", "edited", "skipped", "rerun"] | AiUnavailableDecision
    edited_value: str | None = None
    feedback_type: str | None = None
    feedback_note: str | None = None
    feedback_category: str | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ActiveRunRecord:
    task: asyncio.Task[None]
    started_at: float
    last_active_at: float
    request_id: str | None = None
    plan_id: str | None = None
    trace_id: str | None = None
    thread_id: str | None = None
    terminal_observer: TerminalRunObserver | None = None


ACTIVE_RUNS: dict[str, ActiveRunRecord] = {}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StreamRunContext:
    """Resolved identifiers and dependencies for an agent stream run."""

    request_id: str
    plan_id: str
    trace_id: str
    run_id: str
    thread_id: str
    payload: JsonObject
    adapter: PlannerToAGUIAdapter
    llm_client: BaseChatModel | None
    summary_llm_client: SummaryModelProtocol | None
    interrupt_manager: InterruptManager
    event_buffer: EventBuffer
    has_last_event_id: bool
    last_sequence: int
    reattach_only: bool
    terminal_observer: TerminalRunObserver | None = None
    resume_payload: JsonValue | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ResolvedStreamIds:
    request_id: str
    plan_id: str
    trace_id: str
    run_id: str
    thread_id: str

    def as_payload(self) -> JsonObject:
        return {
            src.key_catalog.PK_REQUEST_ID: self.request_id,
            src.key_catalog.PK_PLAN_ID: self.plan_id,
            src.key_catalog.PK_TRACE_ID: self.trace_id,
            "thread_id": self.thread_id,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ResolvedStreamModels:
    llm_client: BaseChatModel | None
    summary_llm_client: SummaryModelProtocol | None


__all__ = (
    "ACTIVE_RUNS",
    "ActiveRunRecord",
    "AgentStreamRequest",
    "InterruptResponse",
    "ResolvedStreamIds",
    "ResolvedStreamModels",
    "StreamRunContext",
)
